_about: Method Mixer rules (PRISM v0.4 §8.1). Affinity = bias + sum(coef x (score - 3)) over the role profile; pace uses (pace - 5.5) / 2.25. The top methods with positive affinity are blended to 100%.

methods.name: Checklist / SOP
methods.why: Standardised, regulated work is best judged against a clear checklist.

methods.name: BARS
methods.why: Observable behaviours can be anchored to concrete examples on a 1-5 scale.

methods.name: Critical incident
methods.why: Safety-critical work needs a record of the moments that matter.

methods.name: Ranking
methods.why: Individual, measurable output can be compared in calibration; in large pools it is tiered for rewards.

methods.name: MBO
methods.why: Senior roles with clear annual objectives suit management by objectives.

methods.name: KPI scorecard
methods.why: Measurable results are tracked on a weighted scorecard.

methods.name: Balanced Scorecard
methods.why: Leaders balance financial, customer, process and people goals.

methods.name: OKRs
methods.why: Uncertain, creative work needs ambitious objectives where 0.7 counts as success.

methods.name: 360° feedback
methods.why: Collaborative and leadership roles are seen best from several angles (kept anonymous).

methods.name: Check-ins
methods.why: Fast-moving work needs frequent conversations, not a once-a-year review.

methods.name: Gamified dashboard
methods.why: High-volume, measurable work responds to real-time leaderboards.
